text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"states a clear opposition and three reasons in the opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It clearly presents a position and previews the main reasons the writer will defend."},{"evidence":"explains malfunction, liability, and expense in separate body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in a more structured way, with distinct paragraphs devoted to different claims."},{"evidence":"\"technology malfunctions all the time\"; \"who is to blame?\"; \"too expensive\"","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It supports its position with multiple concrete lines of reasoning rather than mostly unsupported assertions."},{"evidence":"uses article details like the 1950s smart-road example and new laws for liability","quality":"textual evidence","description":"It draws more directly on information from the source article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"\"There will need to be all new laws to avoid conflicts\"","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It acknowledges a practical problem raised by the issue and explains why that problem matters."},{"evidence":"ending restates the position and reasons","quality":"conclusion","description":"It provides a closing that summarizes the argument rather than ending abruptly."}]}
